note: generated by scripts/failure_statistics.py; do not edit by hand. Counts of why selected runs failed, not a success rate (selected, non-representative lists; docs/FAILURE_STATISTICS.md, selection bias).

categories.name: missing_python_module
categories.meaning: the program stopped because a Python module was not installed (`No module named ...`)

categories.name: install_package_not_found
categories.meaning: the installation of the listed requirements failed: no matching distribution (package or wheel), no version satisfies the pin, or the pins conflict

categories.name: read_only_write
categories.meaning: the program tried to write into the repository, which is mounted read-only (`Read-only file system`)

categories.name: data_or_network_missing
categories.meaning: a data file was not there, or a download needed a network (the sandbox has none): `No such file or directory`, name resolution failures, connection errors

categories.name: ran_no_metric_line
categories.meaning: the command finished (exit code 0) but printed no line with a metric that the extractor can read

categories.name: timeout
categories.meaning: the run reached its time limit

categories.name: out_of_memory
categories.meaning: the container was killed for using more memory than its limit

categories.name: api_key_missing
categories.meaning: the program asked for an API key that the sandbox does not have

categories.name: wrong_argument
categories.meaning: the command line was rejected (`unrecognized arguments`, a required argument missing)

categories.name: not_run_command_incomplete
categories.meaning: not run: the README command holds only placeholders

categories.name: not_run_judged_not_repairable
categories.meaning: not run in any round: the repair round judged from the repository's files that no allowed repair could make it run

categories.name: staging_failed
categories.meaning: the repository could not be staged (cloned and prepared) for the run

categories.name: ran_without_installed_dependencies
categories.meaning: the install failed but the command ran and exited with 0 (a script that needs no package)

categories.name: other
categories.meaning: none of the rules above matched the deciding line (or there is no deciding line)
